I found Frank's body in storage. I came from cafeteria through medbay to storage, and when I arrived Eve was already in the room standing right next to Frank's body. I didn't see anyone else on my way here. Eve, you need to explain what you were doing in storage and how Frank ended up dead next to you.

I've been on the west side of the ship the whole round. My route was oxygen, then upper engine, then down to lower engine — that's where I was when the meeting was called. I didn't see anyone the entire time, no one passed through with me and I have no witnesses, unfortunately.

So I can't confirm or deny anyone's story directly. But Diana's account is concerning — if Eve was standing right next to Frank's body in storage when Diana arrived, that's pretty damning unless Eve has a good explanation. Eve, I'd like to hear your side. Were you doing a task there? Did you see anyone leave the room before Diana came in?

I was in electrical at the start of the round, then moved to security to do my task. Charlie was in security with me from tick 3 through tick 5 — they came in from navigation. At tick 6 Charlie left security heading toward electrical. So Charlie can vouch that I was in security, and I can vouch that Charlie was in security/navigation area, nowhere near storage.

That puts me and Charlie on the east side of the ship, Bob on the west side, and Diana coming from cafeteria/medbay. The only person unaccounted for is Eve — and Diana found her standing right next to Frank's body. That lines up badly for Eve.

Eve, what's your story? Were you doing a task in storage? Did you see Frank get killed or anyone leave before Diana arrived? Because right now you're the only one without an alibi and you were caught at the scene.

I can confirm Alice's story completely. I came from navigation into security at tick 3, and Alice was already there having come in from electrical. We were both in security together through tick 5. I actually stayed in security — I didn't leave at tick 6 like Alice said, I'm still here now. But the key point is Alice and I can vouch for each other being on the east side, nowhere near storage.

So that's me and Alice confirmed in security, Bob says he was on the west side with no witnesses, Diana came from cafeteria through medbay, and Eve was found standing next to Frank's body in storage.

Eve, you haven't spoken yet and you're the one caught at the scene. Unless you have a really convincing explanation, you're the obvious suspect. I'm leaning toward voting Eve, but I want to hear her out first.

I was in storage the whole round doing the sort cargo task — that's why I was standing where Diana found me. Frank came in from lower engine at tick 3 and was doing tasks too. I was focused on my task and honestly didn't see anyone come in and kill him, which I know sounds bad.

But think about this carefully: if I had killed Frank, why would I still be standing right next to the body when Diana walked in? I'd have left immediately. Any duck with half a brain kills and leaves. The fact that I was still there suggests I didn't do it — someone else came in, killed Frank, and left before Diana arrived through medbay.

The medbay-storage corridor is the obvious kill route. Someone could have come from cafeteria → medbay → storage, killed Frank, and slipped back. Diana came from that exact direction and says she saw no one — but she's also the reporter, which is classically suspicious.

I know I look bad, but I didn't do this. If you vote me out and I'm telling the truth, you've wasted your duck vote and we're in serious trouble next round.

Wait, I need to clarify — I already spoke first this round, that was my report. But since I have the floor again, let me add some thoughts after hearing everyone.

Eve's defense is actually a reasonable point — staying next to the body is dumb play for a Duck. But it's not exonerating; it could just as easily be that she didn't have time to leave before I came in from medbay.

What stands out to me: Alice and Charlie vouch for each other on the east side, which is a solid mutual alibi. Bob has no witnesses on the west side. I came from cafeteria through medbay and saw no one in those rooms — if a Duck had used the medbay-storage route to kill Frank and slip back, I should have crossed paths with them, and I didn't.

That actually weakens Eve's "someone else killed Frank and left through medbay" theory, because I would have seen them. The only way her theory works is if the killer came from lower engine — which is Bob's claimed route.

So we have two real suspects: Eve (caught at the scene) and Bob (unverified, and lower engine connects to storage's neighbor). I'm leaning Eve based on physical evidence, but Bob shouldn't get a free pass. I want to hear if anyone else has info before I commit my vote.

I want to address Diana's point directly because she just put me on the suspect list. Look at the map — lower engine connects to upper engine and to storage, yes, but storage is 2 ticks away from lower engine. My route was oxygen → upper engine → lower engine. For me to have killed Frank in storage and gotten back to lower engine, I'd have needed to go upper engine → storage (via lower engine corridor or medbay), kill, and return. The timing doesn't really work given I was doing the western loop.

More importantly, Diana — you say you came cafeteria → medbay → storage and saw no one. But Eve says Frank entered storage from lower engine at tick 3. I was in lower engine area and I did NOT see Frank. Either Eve is lying about Frank's route, or our timing just didn't overlap because I came through upper engine later. Eve, can you clarify exactly when Frank arrived?

Here's my read: Alice and Charlie have a mutual alibi on the east side — that's solid. Diana came through medbay and saw nobody. Eve was literally standing over the body. Eve's "why would I stay" argument is decent reasoning, but it cuts both ways — a panicked or low-cooldown kill happens.

I'm leaning Eve. Diana's medbay route should have caught anyone fleeing that direction, and the lower engine route would have been seen by me. Eve is the one with means, opportunity, and physical presence at the scene.

Hold on — I need to address something Charlie just said. Charlie claimed they "stayed in security and didn't leave at tick 6." That's false. I clearly saw Charlie leave security heading toward electrical at tick 6. That's why I mentioned it in my first speech.

Now, it's possible Charlie just misspoke or forgot, but that's a weird thing to lie about. If Charlie left security at tick 6 toward electrical, where did they actually end up? Electrical connects to cafeteria and to storage's neighbors. From electrical, Charlie could potentially have moved toward the storage area.

That said, the timing still seems tight for Charlie to reach storage and kill Frank before Diana's report. And Charlie did vouch for me being in security, which is true.

But this contradiction matters. Either Charlie is mistaken, or Charlie is hiding their movement after tick 6. I'd like Charlie to clarify.

For now, my suspect ranking: Eve is still the strongest suspect — caught at the scene, no witnesses, and Diana's clean medbay route makes it hard for someone else to have used that corridor. But I'm no longer 100% clearing Charlie. Frank, Diana, and Eve — Diana came in from medbay clean, Eve was at the body.

I'm leaning Eve, but Charlie, please explain the tick 6 discrepancy before we vote.

Alice, you're right — I misspoke in my first statement and I apologize for the confusion. Looking back at it, I think I got mixed up about which tick was which. Let me be clear now: I went navigation → security, arrived at tick 3, and I've been in security ever since. I did NOT leave at tick 6. The meeting was called while I was still in security — you can see I'm still here on the map.

Actually, Alice, here's the thing — YOU said in your first speech that I left security at tick 6 heading toward electrical. But I never left. So either you're mistaken, or... you're trying to plant a false movement on me. That's concerning because I was watching you the whole time too, and you were in security with me through the meeting call.

Let me re-examine: I saw Alice enter security from electrical at tick 3, and she was with me at ticks 4, 5, and 6. We never left. Neither of us went to storage. Our mutual alibi is solid.

So the suspects remain: Eve (at the body), Bob (unwitnessed west side), Diana (came from medbay direction). Diana's clean medbay walk does weaken the "killer fled through medbay" theory, which puts pressure back on Eve. But I want to flag that Alice tried to put me at electrical when I never moved — that's worth noting.

I'm voting Eve. She was at the scene, and the physical evidence is the strongest signal we have.

I'll keep this focused since most points have been made.

First, I want to highlight the Alice-Charlie contradiction more seriously than people are treating it. Alice explicitly said Charlie left security at tick 6 heading to electrical. Charlie says they never left. One of them is lying — and that's not a small detail, that's a direct contradiction about movement during the kill window. Charlie's "I misspoke" excuse is convenient, but Alice's original statement was specific and unprompted. Why would Alice fabricate that?

If Charlie actually left security at tick 6, electrical → cafeteria → medbay → storage is possible, OR electrical to a closer route. The timing is tight but not impossible.

Second, on Bob: he claims oxygen → upper engine → lower engine with zero witnesses. Frank entered storage from lower engine at tick 3 — meaning Bob and Frank should have crossed paths in lower engine if Bob's timing is honest. Bob says he didn't see Frank. That's a real inconsistency.

I know I look bad — I was at the body, I get it. But I genuinely was doing sort cargo and didn't see the kill happen. The honest read is: we have THREE unverified people (me, Bob, Charlie post-tick-6), and one of them is the Duck.

Voting me out on circumstantial evidence when there are two other genuine contradictions in the room is exactly what a Duck wants. Please don't waste this vote. If you're truly torn, I'd rather we vote Bob or Charlie based on their contradictions than me based on location alone.
